remarks: Located in the charming village like section of Noroton in Darien, directly across from Rings End Road this almost new construction 1 BR/1 Bath unit with HC accessible bath is a corner unit with oversized windows, open floor plan, eat-in kitchen w/quartz countertops, Bosch appliances, full-size LG washer/dryer and LVT plank flooring. A secure access building, CCTV, 3 stop elevator, reserved parking space for residents and lower-level storage locker. Convenient to stores, food services and town amenities including two public beaches. Tenant responsible for credit check, tenant application, all utilities including gas heat, electricity, phone/internet/cable and insurance. First months rent and one month security deposit due at signing of lease. No smoking, pet restrictions.
